scores.observation: Cream/green/gold wrap costume, cream cloth headwrap and friendly face produce a clear civic silhouette. Headwrap stays fitted in inspected front/back/side/angles; continuous lower wrap remains coherent in sampled walk. No authored work witness in the requested report.

Cream blouse, dark navy skirt, orange sash and large bun separate this merchant from the herbalist. Front/back/talk/sell/walk preserve readable face and skirt outline; no inherited supplier basket is rendered.

Broad build, beard, blue-gray shirt, crimson apron/sash, fitted white headband and block hammer retain forge identity. Hammer remains visible and clear of floor/body in inspected body/work views. Hand/prop closeups show open fingers and occlusion, so complete grasp or local finger clearance is not certified.

White buttoned blouse, dark red-brown long skirt, green forearm details/sandals and bun retain a readable medicine-vendor costume. Both gather and grind witnesses preserve the source body outline. No held medicine tool is present in these samples; those labels do not prove work mechanics.

Black/crimson costume, older face and open-palmed pose retain occult identity, but the red procedural headband projects forward as a stiff crescent above the brow. Side idle/talk/walk/chant corroborate the headwear-fit defect. Sit witness is standing visual fallback.

Bare athletic torso, red shorts, broad cream waist cloth, wrist/ankle wraps and head detail create the strongest martial silhouette in this set. Open palms during box work do not obscure the role at gameplay scale. No fist geometry or boxing-mechanics certification requested.

Gray hair, older broad face, cream wrap shirt, green waist panel and wide dark brown trousers distinguish the teacher from the herbal vendor. Open-palmed talk/grind/walk preserve the costume and body outline; no grinding implement/mechanic is certified.

Cream/gold long coat, red sash, topknot and tall brown staff form a clear ritual silhouette, including the gameplay crop. Native hands remain open. Staff appears aligned beside the hand in body/detail views and sampled bottom stays above floor when tilted. No full grasp/contact proof; sit-chant stands as explicit visual fallback.

scoreLimits: Art Bible >=8/10 gate applies to bounded sampled visual presentation. Technical score is visible body/wardrobe/headwear/tool usability; not complete skin topology/anatomy, continuous collision, planted feet, grip, seating or production performance certification.

findings.title: Procedural red headband projects as a rigid crescent/visor
findings.observation: Idle and talk full-resolution side images show the red strip jutting forward beyond the forehead/nose silhouette instead of following a tied forehead band. Front/three-quarter and sampled walk/chant corroborate the raised crescent. Eyes are still visible; this is a headwear fit/style defect, not a claim of face obstruction in every angle.
findings.identity: Rendered receipt contactWitness.props names the actual separate part headband in frame head.
findings.action: Parent can refit only the family headband/socket to the actual head, or use explicit active-model suppressedAccessories: ['headband']. Keep the source body, native animations, black/crimson wardrobe, authored sit schedule and services. Suppression must remain distinct from bakedAccessories and leave procedural fallback/other families unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Fresh front/back/side/three-quarter idle, talk, chant and walk views at multiple times plus gameplay must show a fitted band or its explicit absence, with no projecting crescent, new head intersection or lost face/costume readability. Actual images must close this P2; runtime/CPU pass alone cannot.

observations.noAdditionalP2Established: No other confirmed major prop float, body/wardrobe intersection, broken limb or skin tear was established in the inspected samples. Projection/occlusion around open hand/hammer/staff does not prove complete 3D clearance.
observations.sourceHands: Open/relaxed source hands retained. Hand count, thumb anatomy and closed grasp not certified. Do not require finger-fist geometry just to turn readable role tools into a purported grip.
observations.muayWork: The box witness is an arm gesture with open hands. Muay role is readable from build/costume/wraps at gameplay scale; actual punching mechanics not approved.
observations.roleWitnesses: Sell/gather/grind/chant file names identify authored states, not proof of transactions, tool contact, medicine processing or seated motion.
observations.wardrobe: Wraps, skirts, broad sash/waist panels, selective gold trim, sandals, martial wraps and ritual staff retain Thai-fantasy identity without demanding added ornament.
observations.gameplay: Registry gameplay views show small isolated characters on an empty plane. Original-scale crops support color-block/silhouette/tool comparison; they do not approve live city/UI contrast or interaction.
